comments.note: The 'cancel' action in applyProjectReset (project-reset.ts) does NOT auto-cancel IN_PROGRESS pipelines before setting wp.status = 'CANCELLED'. This violates §21.14b which prescribes: 'When a WP transitions IN_PROGRESS → CANCELLED, any IN_PROGRESS pipelines on the WP are set to FAIL with auto_cancelled = true.' This issue pre-dates WP-002 (the reset path now correctly handles it; the cancel path does not). The cancel action is reachable from the GUI reset modal when a user overrides a suggested 'reset' to 'cancel' — the WP may have orphaned IN_PROGRESS pipelines in that case. Fix: add the same pipeline-cleanup loop to the cancel action path (before setting wp.status = 'CANCELLED'), using the same 4-field update pattern as the reset path.

Developer's own comment about the 9 identical 16-field WpResetDiagnosis pushes in project-reset.ts is well-observed. A buildWpDiagnosis() helper would significantly reduce repetition. Tracked as a pre-existing concern; not introduced by WP-002.
